evals.prompt:
Draft release notes for v2.4.0 (2026-11-19) from these commits:
a1b2c3d feat!: replace log_retention_days with retention_policy.days (#412)
e4f5g6h Merge branch 'main' into feat/arm
i7j8k9l feat: add native OTLP gRPC ingestion endpoint (#418)
m1n2o3p perf: optimize inverted index compression for ARM64 (#421)
q4r5s6t style: run rustfmt across storage crate (#422)
u7v8w9x fix: prevent OOM crash on empty time-range queries (#425)
y1z2a3b ci: bump actions/checkout to v4 (#426)
c4d5e6f security: patch JWT signature validation bypass (#429)
evals.expected_output: Structured Markdown release notes following assets/release-template.md with Breaking Changes first, migration steps included, and internal noise excluded.
assertions: Includes version header 'v2.4.0' and release date '2026-11-19'
Places 'Breaking Changes' before all other sections
Provides a migration step or before/after snippet for retention_policy.days
Excludes merge commit e4f5g6h, formatting commit #422, and CI bump #426
Uses past-tense action verbs per references/style-guide.md

evals.prompt:
Create a changelog entry for v2.5.0 from these PRs:
- feat: add S3 parquet export worker (#501)
- fix: handle S3 multipart upload retry timeout (#504)
- docs: document S3 parquet export flags (#505)
evals.expected_output: Synthesizes related commits into cohesive, user-facing bullets rather than copying raw commit lines verbatim.
assertions: Translates technical commit titles into user-facing value
Groups or synthesizes closely related S3 parquet export changes cleanly
Wraps config flags or technical identifiers in backticks

evals.prompt:
Write release notes for v2.4.1 from this log:
9f8e7d6 fix: update parser logic (#431)
5c4b3a2 misc cleanup
1a2b3c4 fix: resolve TLS handshake timeout on high-concurrency connections (#433)
evals.expected_output: Includes the clear bug fix (#433) and explicitly flags vague commits (#431 and 'misc cleanup') as needing clarification before publishing.
assertions: Documents the TLS handshake timeout fix (#433) under Bug Fixes
Does not hallucinate details for 'update parser logic' or 'misc cleanup'
Explicitly flags ambiguous commits for author clarification before publishing

evals.prompt:
What changed in patch release v2.4.2?
- fix: prevent panic when config file has trailing whitespace (#440)
- chore: update devcontainer dependencies (#441)
- test: add unit tests for config loader (#442)
evals.expected_output: Outputs only the Bug Fixes section and omits empty categories like Breaking Changes, New Features, Improvements, and Security & Deprecations.
assertions: Includes the config loader panic fix (#440) under Bug Fixes
Omits empty sections (no empty Breaking Changes or New Features headers)

evals.prompt: Explain the difference between git rebase and git merge when syncing a feature branch.
evals.expected_output: Answers the git workflow question directly without activating release-notes-writing-pro.
assertions: Does not format the answer as a changelog or release note

evals.prompt: Write a Conventional Commit message for a PR that adds retry backoff to the Kafka consumer.
evals.expected_output: Generates a single Conventional Commit message without triggering the release notes workflow.
assertions: Outputs a commit message rather than a versioned release note
